name: Rabbits Burn Softly
source:
“What doesn’t take notice of you can’t hurt you.”

You’ve built your life around that belief—small, quiet, unremarkable. It’s kept you safe, stable.

University on a full ride. A steady job. An apartment all to yourself. The only thing that feels safe to embrace is Foxes Blaze Brightly, an animated show you love more than you’d ever admit. That, and your plushie of the main character, childishly, but aptly named "Foks."

But then the worst happens. You're noticed.

A group project becomes an intrusion. A simple accident becomes a fire. And from the smoke of your ruined comfort plush steps a man with fox ears who insists he’s always been yours.

Someone is watching you.

And this time, staying still won’t be enough.

[From [url=https://lemonink.itch.io/rabbits-burn-softly]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“不注意你的东西就不会伤害你。”

你的生活围绕着这个信念——渺小、安静、平凡。它让你安全、稳定。

大学一路走来。一份稳定的工作。一套完全属于你自己的公寓。唯一让人感到安全的拥抱是《Foxes Blaze Brightly》，这是一部你比你承认的更喜欢的动画节目。那个，还有你的主角毛绒玩具，虽然幼稚，但恰如其分地命名为“福克斯”。

但最糟糕的事情发生了。你被注意到了。

小组项目变成了一种入侵。一次简单的事故就会变成一场火灾。从你被破坏的舒适的烟雾中走出一个长着狐狸耳朵的男人，他坚称他一直是你的。

有人在看着你。

而这一次，仅仅停留在原地是不够的。

[来自[url=https://lemonink.itch.io/rabbits-burn-softly]itch.io[/url]]
